description: Welcome to 5319 Calabria Way, a well-maintained single-story home in North Natomas. Offering 3 bedrooms, 2 bathrooms, and 1,507 square feet of functional living spaces, this home blends comfort, convenience, and affordability. A 220V EV charger and WiFi-enabled garage door opener bring modern convenience to your daily commute, while recent updates like a new 65-gallon electric water heater (2025), new garbage disposal (2026), and new GE microwave and hood (2026) mean less to worry about from day one. Set on a low-maintenance 5,397-square-foot lot, the location keeps daily life simple. Nearby parks, trails, and recreational facilities include North Natomas Regional Park, Lilac Park, Regency Park, and a community aquatic complex, while Raley's, Natomas Marketplace, and Sacramento Gateway place shopping, dining, and errands within easy reach. With quick access to I-5, Downtown Sacramento, and Sacramento International Airport, this is a home that delivers convenient and affordable North Natomas living.
